:::{#def-one-se-rule}
#### One-standard-error rule

Let $M_1, \ldots, M_L$ be candidate models ordered from least to most flexible.
Write $\cvestof{k}{M_l}$ for the [cross-validation estimate](#def-cv-estimate) of model $M_l$
and $\cvse(M_l)$ for its [standard error](#def-cv-se),
all computed with the same folds,
and let $M_{l^*}$ be the model with the smallest estimate.
The **one-standard-error rule** chooses the least flexible model $M_l$
whose estimate is within one standard error of the smallest:

$$
\cvestof{k}{M_l} \le \cvestof{k}{M_{l^*}} + \cvse(M_{l^*}).
$$ {#eq-one-se-rule}
